Conditional κ = 0.001674083482880778: whole-owner map at the packing optimum of the seven-slot k8 word

New package research/gauge44-slots-arcflow, stacked on the #1005/#1018 chain (this branch contains that chain's packages unchanged, as in #1055). Only the owner map changes: data/OWNERS.json.gz, the profile of data/PLAN.json, the re-derived data/SPEC.json, RESULT.json, the regenerated independent price receipt, the κ pin and the search/recount scripts. The seven-slot k8 word c2b29430…, its 72-call schedule, the idle stock and windows, and PR589's bit supplier are unchanged.

  | κ | idle remainder -- | -- | -- this package (T = 8) | 0.001674083482880778 | {1:1214, 2:1, 32:1, 48:2443} research/gauge44-slots-t16 (chain's best) | 0.001672251604432734 | {1:2249, 2:1, 3:406, 7:5, 16:36, 48:4853} per 16 replicas research/gauge44-slots (#1018) | 0.00167166528321877 | {1:1099, 2:9, 3:179, 7:54, 16:23, 48:2419} selected #942 | 0.001661960547713947 |  

That is +0.1095% over the chain's best and +0.7294% over the selected result. The complex side binds (lower endpoint 0.001676890737967805674397).

Why this is the ceiling of the family at eight replicas. The windowed aggregate LP over bin patterns per (owner replica, idle child) class and per-call width counts has optimum 1215.57 rank-1 remainders, equal to the time-free relaxation, so the owner windows do not bind. The integer optimum of the time-free pattern model is exactly {1:1214, 2:1, 32:1} (HiGHS, proved optimal), which this map attains. At any replica count the time-free bound is at least 151.95 rank-1 remainders per replica, so T = 16 or 37 could add at most about 1.5·10⁻⁸.

How it was found. An exactly liftable MILP over pattern counts n(c,p) and per-pattern time incidences x(c,p,t,w) (each port takes at most one helper per call; Σ_t x = n·mult_p(w); every call's inventory is placed inside its windows) solves in seconds once the patterns are restricted to the LP support. Each pattern's times × positions multigraph has maximum degree n and is properly n-edge-coloured (König); every colour class is one literal port, offsets are the partial sums of the pattern. construction/owners/search_owners.py is a search input only; construction/owners/recount_owners.py (standard library) recounts the frozen map.

Verification (explicit reuse of a completed #1005 replay, as research/gauge44-slots does):

python -B research/gauge44-slots-arcflow/verify_manifest.py
python -B research/gauge44-slots-arcflow/construction/slots/verify_slots.py \
  --main . --pr635 /tmp/gauge44-pr635 --baseline /tmp/lvc --work /tmp/slots-arcflow
# PASS_ARCFLOW_OWNERS_ON_CHECKED_K8_SLOT_BASELINE 0.001674083482880778
python -I -B research/gauge44-slots-arcflow/construction/owners/recount_owners.py
# PASS_OWNERS_RECOUNT

All stages pass locally (Linux, Python 3.12): baseline pins, slot layer and its 34 controls, native locals, independent audit_local, and the strict global replay (restore-parent, bind, emit, audit with mutation controls, invoice, assembly, 69 admission controls, 12 bit-supplier controls). independent/price_profile.py gives the same κ (PASS_FROZEN_PROFILE_TWO_EXACT_ENGINE_AND_OUTER47_CROSSCHECK).

Scope. A finite conditional witness on a pending construction; every assumption of the #1005/#1018 chain is inherited (all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer, bit H1–H5). No optimality beyond the stated T = 8 whole-helper family is claimed.

Credit. Prepared by G. V. Chudnovsky with Anthropic Claude assistance (Apache-2.0). The word and everything below the owner map are the #1005/#1018 chain's: icekylinx's #645 gauge44 chain rebuilt by PartialK, G44Stack, NoTriReopen, BlockInvert, BRoute, chafreaky's #741 frames, JointXF, NewBArch, LeaverSAT/LeaverSAT2, rohanarun's #987 slots, G44Pack/G44Pack3's plan, Hao Yan's #858 T16 machinery (comparison only), and the PR589 bit supplier; see NOTICE.md.
